title: git-toolkit REVIEW output finding
description: One JSON object per finding emitted by a git-toolkit capability running in REVIEW mode. Files using this schema are NDJSON: one object per line. See references/review-output.md for the prose spec.

rule.description: Kebab-case rule identifier matching a rule section in references/format-conventions.md or another reference. Examples: imperative-mood, subject-length, body-wrap, trailers-preserved.

result.description: Outcome of evaluating the rule against the target. Use N/A for rules that do not apply (e.g., trailer rules on a commit with no trailers).

scope.description: The unit the rule was evaluated against.

ref.description: Branch name or ref this finding pertains to (for scope=branch/range/pr).

sha.description: Short or full commit SHA this finding pertains to (for scope=commit).

subject.description: Commit subject line for scope=commit findings; helps readers identify the commit without re-running git log.

count_checked.description: For aggregate findings (scope=branch/range), how many items were evaluated.

count_failed.description: For aggregate findings, how many failed.

max_length.description: For length-based PASS findings on aggregates, the maximum observed length.

limit.description: For length-based rules, the cap the rule enforces.

details.description: Rule-specific structured data. Field set varies per rule; excerpt is reserved across rules for a verbatim quote from the target.

line.description: Line number within the target (1-based) where the issue was found.

length.description: Measured length in display columns (not bytes) — see format-conventions.md.

excerpt.description: Verbatim quote from the target showing the issue.

fix.description: Short imperative describing the corrective action. Never includes an apply command (those belong in the human-facing markdown output, not the NDJSON stream).

allOf.$comment: scope=commit findings should carry a sha.
scope=branch / range / pr findings should carry a ref.
FAIL and MOSTLY-PASS findings should carry a fix.
